title: Anthropic puts a coordinator above Claude Code agents
teaser: Anthropic has launched Claude Code Projects, a beta feature that turns Claude Code from a sequence of coding sessions into a persistent project coordinator. Developers can describe a long-running goal in ordinary language, while Claude splits the work across parallel cloud sessions, tracks dependencies, and carries decisions from one stream into the next. The shift matters because software projects rarely end after one prompt or one pull request: they accumulate requirements, exceptions and unfinished work that coding agents must now remember.
